The '''Junker Jott's Storehouse''' was a storehouse owned by [[Junker Jott]], within the [[Asteroid base|asteroid station]] [[Mek-Sha]]. During the [[Third Galactic War]], agents of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Mission to Mek-Sha|attacked]] the storehouse.<ref name="TOR:StP" />
